NCT07001384.title: A Study of Alectinib and Duvelisib in People With Anaplastic Lymphoma Kinase-Positive Anaplastic Large Cell Lymphoma (ALK+ALCL)

interventions.name: Alectinib
interventions.description: All patients will receive a lead-in cycle (28 days) of alectinib.

interventions.name: Duvelisib
interventions.description: After the lead-in cycle of alectinib, in the absence of progressive disease as assessed by PET/CT scan, all patients will then receive two 28-day cycles of alectinib plus duvelisib.
